typeInfo.description: Its high ammo capacity and rapid-firing feature make it perfect for dealing with swarming enemies.

description:
Rapi, who has truly inherited the essence of Red Hood, equips herself with the weapon, Seven Dwarves Zero, which is engraved with their cherished promise.
She seeks to become the Goddess of Victory and reclaim the surface.

levels.name: Battlefield Assessment
levels.description:
■ Activates at the start of battle and when Full Burst ends.

lines.text:
Commander,
I have some thoughts regarding the next mission.

All systems are go.
I don't think it could get any better than this.

What do you think of me, Commander?
I'm curious to hear your thoughts.
I'm looking forward to seeing what we'll do together.
I do not die or break. Not under any circumstance.
I will carry on what has been passed down to me. In the meantime, I ask that you watch over me.
For the time being, may I tend to some personal matters?

I'm on the lookout for music that aligns with my taste.
I hope I can find some this time.
Speaking of which, it's been a long time since you've been here.

It may be because so much has happened,
but it almost feels like home.
Personally, I think there should be a hidden room in the Commander's Room.
Once again, I'm counting on you, Commander.

Maximum output increased.
I can do even more now.

Physical upgrade confirmed.
I wonder how far I can push this?

Battle data updated.
It's fascinating to think how I can still grow stronger this way.
Is there anything you need, Commander?

You always give me so much...
This isn't affecting your finances, is it?

I've wanted this all along.
You really know me better than I know myself.

Commander. Perhaps...
No, it's nothing.

Do you have a moment?
There's something I'd like to discuss with you.
I won't let you down. Ever.
Roger. Joining the mission.
Awaiting orders.
Proceeding to target.
Encounter.

Engaging with enemy.
Commander, stay behind me.
Enemy spotted. Engaging.
... Watch over me.
Reload.
I've got this.
How heavy your burden has been...
Seven Dwarves Zero...!
Fully active! Pierce through!
Target! Ahead! Fire at will!
Target down.
Target clear.
Enemy down.
Ugh.
Tsk.
Ugh.
I'll fall back for a moment. I'll leave the rest to you.
As long as we're together, I will never fall.

It appears you are unable to take your eyes off my swimsuit. 
I am glad it is to your liking.
Commander, will you accompany me for a swim?

The water temperature and breeze are perfect.
Maybe it's because you're here with me that everything feels truly complete.

It's still too soon for anything else,
but if you want, holding hands is fine.

Allow me to apply the sunscreen for you.
It's... something I've always wanted to try.

Danger always seems to find us during the summer,
but there is no need for concern, Commander. I'll ensure you are well protected.

Perhaps it is the heat,
but the wait feels unusually long today.

There is no need for such unease. 
I will be here, waiting for you as I always do.
Since I'm wearing a swimsuit for once, I might as well go to the pool. Why don't you come with me, Commander? Just the two of us.
I hope Neon and Anis will be able to join us next time as well.

What are you looking at, Commander?
... I don't mind. You can keep looking.

I got this swimsuit because I thought you'd like it.
What do you think, Commander?
Yes, this is enough to make me stronger.

This feels good.
But I can still improve further.
I can't help but wonder how strong I can become when I'm with you, Commander.
Are you trying to make a move on me, Commander? All right, I'll let it slide.
I can see where your tastes lie. I'll put this to good use.
You know me better than I know myself. You even know exactly what I like.
Such a warm feeling... this must be because of you, Commander.
I do not think the heat is the only reason my heart is racing.
My devotion towards you will never waver.
Let's go, Commander.
What are your orders?
Moving to the designated location.
Encounter.
Target confirmed, commencing operation.
I shall suppress them swiftly.
I will protect the Commander.
Reloading.
Aren't you staring a bit too intently?
I will finish this quickly.
I'm ready.
This way, Commander. There is no need to hesitate.
Up ahead, commence firing!
Neutralized.
Target eliminated.
Target down.
Uh.
Ugh.
Ah!

The perfect opportunity for us to be alone doesn't come around often.
It's truly regrettable.

Commander. The disruptive elements have been removed. 
May we continue our date now?
I'm feeling a little tired. I'll rest on your bed for a moment, Commander.
Commander... what do you think of this pillow? The design's rather nice, isn't it?

I heard you like these kinds of outfits, Commander.
Feel free to take a good look.
Aren't you tired, Commander? You can rest. I'll stay here and keep watch over you.
Whatever you ask of me, Commander, my answer will always be "yes."

Hehe, your reaction makes this all worth it... 
Since I worked so hard, may I ask for a reward?
Like this...? No, maybe a bit more demurely...
Commander, would you like to... Oh, I see you're busy. I guess I'll just stay by your side for now.

Oh, Commander. I was just about to head to my room to rest.
Would you like to come with me?
What do I have to do to wake up in the same bed as the Commander?

Hm? I'm not particularly embarrassed...
... But I guess acting demure really does work after all.

Hello, Commander.
You look exhausted. Shall we get some rest together?

I will become stronger.
For the sake of our future.

For you, Commander,
I can always grow stronger.
Yes, I need to be stronger so I can keep up with you, Commander.
I'll try acting demure, Commander. Will you tell me if you like it?
Commander, I've prepared a reward for you. Please come to my room tonight.

Thank you, Commander.
My reward for you... is myself.

Commander. I...
No. It's nothing.
Sometimes I feel that as long as you're by my side, nothing else matters.

I'll do my best to express my feelings
to you more clearly, Commander.

Do you prefer being outside?
... That was a joke.
Yes, Commander.
Let's hurry. There is work to be done when we get back.
Encounter.
I'll finish this quickly.
Hopefully the Commander and I... Never mind.
Commander. Please wait a little longer.
I'm not being impatient.
I'm perfectly calm right now.
Reloading. Swiftly.
Commander. I'm all set.
I look forward to welcoming the morning with you.
Fire at will! Take them down quickly!
Target silenced. Redirecting fire.
Enemy neutralized.
Only a few enemies remain.
Ow!
... Ugh.
Ah...
Forgive me. I'll rest first.
It's over. Now, let us rest together, Commander.
